The '''NIL-8 Assassin Droid''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] droid with two arms, two legs, a chest-mounted [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], and armor. It stood two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was coated with non-reflective black metal, with a head resembling a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]]. It was employed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor]] to hunt prisoners through his [[Game Chambers]].
